note: Human edits to the foreman's o-1 draft, logged separately from the model. Each edit names the draft item it acts on by id; a draft from a new run may use other ids, so this file is written for the draft in the run it resumes. take.ps1 applies scope_edits to the draft in order, then choice_rules to the open choices, then sends the result as one revise_scope through the owner's member HTTP route, and logs each edit as a human step. An op whose id is not in the draft stops the take (fail closed). Nothing here is a verdict: the edits state the order's rules and the gate checks them.

The current short-code form is stated by the may item i-code-format. If a draft offers an option that keeps 7, take.ps1 answers that option instead and the choice stays open until confirmed.
